name: 18641 · Avoca, PA
findings: ZIP 18641 (Avoca) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18641 (Avoca) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
